# Finding Alexx

> > Travel guides and resources for solo female travelers exploring destinations across Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.

Finding Alexx provides comprehensive destination guides featuring practical travel planning advice, itineraries, and booking resources through partners like Skyscanner, Booking.com, GetYourGuide, and Klook. The site focuses on empowering independent travelers with detailed country and regional guides.

## Key Topics

- travel planning
- destination guides

- [All Destination Travel Guides](https://findingalexx.com/destinations): Main directory of all destination guides organized by country/continent

- [Africa & Middle East Travel Guides](https://findingalexx.com/africa-middle-east): Regional hub for Africa & Middle East guides (Morocco, Jordan, UAE)

## Europe Destinations

- [Iceland](https://findingalexx.com/iceland): Iceland travel guide covering Golden Circle & Snæfellsnes Peninsula
- [Finland](https://findingalexx.com/finland): Finland guide covering Lapland, Rovaniemi & northern lights experiences
- [Italy](https://findingalexx.com/italy): Italy travel guides for Amalfi Coast, Rome, Florence & Venice
- [The Ultimate Cornwall Road Trip](https://findingalexx.com/web-stories/the-ultimate-cornwall-road-trip-story): Cornwall road trip itinerary with Kynance Cove & St Michael's Mount

## Asia Destinations

- [Thailand](https://findingalexx.com/thailand): Thailand travel guide featuring Bangkok & Andaman Sea destinations
